walk.description: How project folders are walked. Lists are added to the built-in ones.

maxDepth.description: How deep below each chosen folder to look.

templates.description: Named layouts for "template" rules. A template with an existing name replaces it.

safety.description: safe: comes back by itself. rebuild: needs the "restore" command. caution: may hold something you can't get back.

id.description: A built-in id overrides that rule; a new id adds one.

eco.description: Ecosystem, e.g. node, rust, python, apple, android, flutter, php, ai, editor, other.

category.description: Tab for location and template rules.

dirs.description: artifact: folder names (or a/b paths) inside the project.

markers.description: artifact: at least one of these files must sit next to the folder. "*" works.

inside.description: artifact: at least one of these must exist inside the folder.

gitIgnored.description: artifact: only list the folder if git ignores it.

paths.description: location / versioned / template: paths. "~", "$VAR", "{bin:tool}" and "*" work.

apps.description: Apps that must be quit before deleting.

keep.description: versioned: how many of the newest to keep. Default 1.
